title: record page: the Related tab gives an empty related list ("客户 0 暂无相关记录") a full row, and record:path squeezes two terminal stages ("× 已取消 客户未到") into one cell at the right edge
body:
Filing gate **① a user-visible defect with a named landing site**; two record-page polish items from one pass, split if triage prefers. Batch-of: 2026-10-25 browser pass on @objectstack/* 18.1.0 (23 cards: hotcrm 10, objectui 10, objectstack 3). Filed by the maintainer's account (`os-steve`) from the HotCRM pass driven in session `session_01AwpXhq2nFKU6J7GmbCEmZu`; ⛔ not a claim. Grade and routing are objectui triage's.

## What is seen (HotCRM on `@objectstack/console` 18.1.0, 1440×900)

1. **Related tab, account Acme Corporation.** Between 报价单 (2) and 活动 (7) sits a full-height row 「客户 0 · 暂无相关记录 · + 新建」 (child accounts), and after 活动 another 「线索 0 · 暂无相关记录 · + 新建」. With 26 related records in nine lists, two of the rows a reader scrolls past are empty. [50-account-related.png](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/03c2ad1573fb93cf1318ab50ae22f9ba770c4166/qa/2026-10-25-browser-pass/shots/50-account-related.png). Expected: empty lists fold to a one-line footer (「其他 2 个为空：客户、线索」) or sort last, keeping their 新建 action.
2. **record:path on an event.** The stage bar has three stages 已计划 / 已举行 / 已取消 plus the terminal 客户未到; the last segment reads `× 已取消  客户未到` in one narrow cell at the right edge while the first two stages take the width. [60-event-tall.png](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/03c2ad1573fb93cf1318ab50ae22f9ba770c4166/qa/2026-10-25-browser-pass/shots/60-event-tall.png). The opportunity bar does the same with 成交 / × 失败, less visibly because it has seven stages. Expected: terminal states share the width equally or wrap, so each label is legible.

`reach:` the public UI, measured once as the dev admin.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` objectui "related tab empty related list with zero records still takes a row" → 6 hits (#13063, objectstack-ai/objectui#12870, objectstack-ai/objectui#12930, objectstack-ai/objectui#12245, objectstack-ai/objectui#11768, objectstack-ai/objectui#11613), none about empty-list layout; "record path stage bar terminal states cancelled no-show overlap cramped at the right" → 3 hits (#12965, objectstack-ai/objectui#5957, objectstack-ai/objectui#5916 — accessibility of the path, closed). Report: [REPORT.md](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/03c2ad1573fb93cf1318ab50ae22f9ba770c4166/qa/2026-10-25-browser-pass/REPORT.md) §4.2, §4.5.
